# Helicycles

Helicycles: pedal-powered orange helicopter pods with pink rotors (HELICAR).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# PaddleBoats

Paddle boats: slate hulls with orange planks and churning stern wheels (SPBOAT).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# BurgerShop

Burger shop: the building IS a giant sesame-bun burger with a serving hatch (BURGB).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# HotDogStand

Hot dog stand: stone kiosk, striped awning, giant hot dog on the roof (HOTDS).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# SodaStand

Soda stand: a cluster of giant soda cans with ring pulls and a straw (DRNKS).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# CottonCandyStand

Cotton candy stand: a giant fluffy pink floss cloud with a hatch (CNDYF).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.
